# `aitbc tee verify`

Verify a TEE quote, attestation, or zero-knowledge proof.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc tee verify [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--quote` | text | — | no | Base64-encoded attestation quote |
| `--attestation-id` | text | — | no | Stored TEE attestation ID to verify |
| `--job-id` | text | — | no | Job whose tee_attestation_id will be verified |
| `--measurement` | text | — | no | Expected measurement to verify against |
| `--zk-proof` | text | — | no | Optional ZK proof identifier for dual verification |
| `--mode` | choice | `tee_only` | no | Verification mode |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc tee verify
```
